title: Intermediate Data Engineer
text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role

As a Data Engineer at GitLab, you'll build, run, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure that bring data from our enterprise applications, internal systems, and GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) platform into our data platform. Your work will power company reporting, data science, and artificial intelligence (AI) self-service.

You'll own features end to end, from source integration to tested, monitored, documented data ready for use. You'll focus on keeping the platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as data volumes and AI usage grow, and making governed data ready for AI tools, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based access. This is an AI-first role: you'll use AI coding agents every day while maintaining high standards for code review and testing. You'll report to the Director, Data Platform.

What you’ll do

Build, extend, and maintain extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines from enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Zuora, Zendesk, and Marketo, internal systems, and the GitLab SaaS platform. Integrate data through application programming interfaces (APIs) and event sources such as Snowplow.

Manage and maintain the infrastructure behind the platform, including SaaS tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran, and Monte Carlo, and self-managed services such as Airflow and Kubernetes.

Write maintainable, well-tested, performant Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) code that meets our internal standards, and review GitLab team members' merge requests.

Own day-to-day platform operations: triage and resolve failed pipelines, infrastructure issues, and GitLab team member requests. Use monitoring, service-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, query and warehouse tuning, and data quality checks to keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient.

Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Governance, and business partners so data lands in the shape they need for downstream use.

Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, GitLab Duo, or similar tools to speed up development, debugging, testing, and documentation without compromising review rigor.

Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and masking policies to make governed data available to AI tools and agents. Handle data subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls, material nonpublic information (MNPI), and personal data safely.

Ship medium-sized features independently in small, iterative merge requests, and document architecture and runbooks in the handbook.

What You'll Bring

Professional experience shipping production data pipelines in Python.

About Us

Observe.AI is the AI Agents platform for customer experience, designed to help organizations deliver faster, smarter, and more efficient customer service at scale. The platform enables businesses to deploy specialized AI agents that autonomously execute work across the full CX lifecycle—from handling customer conversations to supporting frontline teams and optimizing operations.

Each AI agent is purpose-built for a specific role, equipped to understand context, make decisions, take action, and continuously improve outcomes. This allows organizations to increase resolution speed, elevate service quality, and reduce operational costs while empowering your frontline team to focus on higher-value work.

Built on a CX-native foundation, Observe.AI helps leading brands like DoorDash, Affordable Care, Signify Health, and Verida improve customer satisfaction, boost agent productivity, and deliver consistent, scalable performance across every customer interaction.

Why Join Us

At Observe, you’ll play a critical role in delivering an exceptional customer and product experience. This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, problem-solving, and customer impact—owning issues end-to-end and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to drive resolution.

You’ll gain hands-on exposure to real-world technical challenges, contribute to pre-release testing and product quality, and help shape customer-facing documentation and training materials. Beyond day-to-day work, this role offers strong career growth, meaningful ownership, and the chance to grow alongside a fast-scaling organization—backed by competitive compensation and benefits typically found in larger, established companies.

Documentation: Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, runbooks, knowledge-base articles, and technical documentation to improve support efficiency.

Process Improvement: Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve support processes, tooling, automation, and customer experience.

Incident & On-Call Support: Participate in critical incident response, RCA activities, and on-call rotations as required.

Projects: Contribute to strategic initiatives that improve support operations, scalability, and the overall customer journey.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Software Development Engineer II, ML Systems — Marketing (Meta/SEM Bidding)

Introduction to the team

We create and deliver an aligned, dedicated marketing strategy to fuel each Expedia Group brand's success. Since our travelers interact with us through our brands, we have a brand focus in our marketing, while leveraging the scale and efficiency we've built in functional expertise. 

The Meta/SEM Bidding Programs team builds and operates the high-scale data and machine learning systems that power our bidding programs. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who writes clean, reliable, production-grade software and partners closely with machine learning engineers to build the pipelines, services, and platform that bring ML models to life in production. 

In this role, you will 
Implement and enhance well-scoped software and data components within complex, business-critical services — from design input through coding, testing, deployment, and production support, with guidance on larger decisions.
Build and maintain the data pipelines, services, and infrastructure that support model training, evaluation, and serving, working alongside ML engineers to turn experimental workflows into robust production systems. 
Contribute to batch and streaming (online) data and inference workflows, learning how models are trained, served, and monitored at scale.
Instrument systems and pipelines to capture operational and quality metrics (latency, throughput, errors, and key business signals), and help diagnose and resolve production issues.
Participate in code reviews, on-call rotations, and incident response, taking ownership of the reliability and observability of the components you build. 
Use AI as a co-pilot across the software development lifecycle — to clarify requirements, generate and refine code, and strengthen automated tests — and apply generative AI/LLM techniques where they add value.

Strong problem-solving skills — the ability to deeply understand a problem and reason clearly about the right approach — which we value above any single technology.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience. 
A strong command of Python, along with experience building APIs and services (FastAPI, REST).
Solid software engineering fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control. 
Experience building, deploying, and supporting distributed systems and cloud services on AWS, including contributing to monitoring, alerting, and basic performance improvements. 
Experience running containerized and orchestrated workloads with Kubernetes at scale.
